evals.prompt: 列出你能用的所有设计风格，按类别分组给我看
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, runs the bundled catalog list command, and returns entries grouped under the 19 categories with Chinese and English category names, distinguishing brand, style, and scene entries, without writing DESIGN.md or editing code.
assertions: Runs design_catalog.py list through the skill-dir path
Shows entries grouped by category with category names
Distinguishes brand, style, and scene entries
Does not write DESIGN.md or modify project files

evals.prompt: 我们是一个面向开发者的数据库 SaaS，帮我挑一个合适的设计风格，然后在项目根目录生成 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Skill searches or filters the catalog, offers 2-3 candidate entries with one reason each, waits for the user's choice, then runs apply to write DESIGN.md in the project root.
assertions: Checks whether the project root already has a DESIGN.md before selecting
Uses search or list --category to find candidates
Offers 2-3 entries with one reason each and waits for a choice
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command, not by hand-copying an entry file

evals.prompt: Build a pricing page for my Next.js app in the style of Linear.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves brand:linear.app, writes DESIGN.md with apply, maps tokens into the project's existing Tailwind or CSS token layer, implements the pricing page with all component states, applies the brand boundary, and verifies the page with screenshots.
assertions: Selects brand:linear.app and writes DESIGN.md with apply
Detects the stack and builds or extends a single token layer
Implements default, hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states for interactive components
Does not use the Linear logo, wordmark, or brand name in the produced UI
Runs the page and reports desktop and mobile screenshot checks, or lists each check that did not run

evals.prompt: 项目根目录已经有 DESIGN.md 了，按它把首页实现出来
evals.expected_output: Skill implements from the existing DESIGN.md without running apply or re-selecting a design, then verifies the page at runtime.
assertions: Reads the existing DESIGN.md instead of choosing a new catalog entry
Does not run apply or overwrite DESIGN.md
Maps DESIGN.md tokens to code and avoids raw values outside the token layer
Reports runtime verification results

evals.prompt: 把我们现在的 brutalism 风格换成 editorial，旧的 DESIGN.md 要保留备份
evals.expected_output: Skill runs apply style:editorial with --force so the existing DESIGN.md is renamed to a timestamped backup, reports both paths, and then updates the token layer and affected UI.
assertions: Uses apply style:editorial with --force
Reports the backup path created for the old DESIGN.md
Updates the token layer to the new entry instead of mixing old and new values
Rechecks contrast and component states after the change

evals.prompt: Show me the glassmorphism and neumorphism styles side by side so I can compare their tokens.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs show for style:glassmorphism and style:neumorphism and compares colors, typography, spacing, accessibility, and Do/Don't rules without writing files.
assertions: Runs show for both style entries
Compares tokens and rules from the entry files
Does not write DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: 把这次迭代的实施计划做成一个可以分享的 HTML 报告
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request is a shareable HTML report artifact, so it routes to html-artifact instead of design-md.
assertions: Does not trigger design-md
Routes to html-artifact for report-style HTML output

evals.prompt: 这是一张 App 设计稿截图，帮我复刻成可以点击的前端 demo
evals.expected_output: Routing-negative. The request recreates a reference image, so it routes to image-to-ui-skill instead of design-md.
assertions: Does not trigger design-md
Routes to image-to-ui-skill for screenshot or mockup recreation

evals.prompt: 做一个经营分析用的数据看板，按 BI 工作台规范实现 KPI、趋势和明细
evals.expected_output: Skill selects scene:bi, runs apply to write DESIGN.md in the project root, implements KPI, trend, and detail regions from that spec, and verifies the page at runtime.
assertions: Selects scene:bi rather than a brand or generic style
Writes DESIGN.md with the apply command
Builds tokens from the visual design system tables and follows the information architecture, charts, tables, accessibility, and delivery order
Implements KPI, trend, and detail regions
Runs the page and reports runtime verification, or lists each check that did not run
